name: 03860 · North Conway, NH
findings: ZIP 03860 (North Conway) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03860 (North Conway) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 03860 (North Conway) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
